chars.HAMZA: HAMZA: a 32-year-old man wearing a bright mustard-yellow polo shirt, dark blue jeans and brown sandals.
chars.IMANE: IMANE: a young woman wearing a long lilac house kaftan and a pink headscarf with small gold earrings.
chars.REDA: REDA: a man the same age wearing a red-and-black checkered flannel shirt, black tracksuit trousers and white sneakers.
chars.RIM: RIM: a tiny 3-year-old girl (half the height of the adults) wearing a sky-blue dress with white polka dots and two small pigtail bows.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cozy modest Casablanca apartment living room with Moroccan sedari sofas. IMANE and REDA sit close together on the sofa laughing loudly at each other; HAMZA stands in the doorway behind them holding his car keys, frowning with suspicion, one eyebrow raised. Funny awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same living room at night. HAMZA sits alone on the sofa with a glass of mint tea, shaking his head and waving one hand as if pushing away a bad thought, forced reassuring smile.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A busy Casablanca street with white Art Deco buildings. HAMZA drives a cream-white Mercedes grand taxi, elbow out of the window, relaxed and smiling, weeks passing.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Blazing hot midday Casablanca street. HAMZA stands next to his cream-white grand taxi wiping sweat from his forehead, exhausted and dizzy from the sun, deciding to go home early.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA opens the front door of the apartment and steps into the living room, surprised; little RIM sits alone on the carpet in the middle of the room playing with a doll and wooden blocks. The house is very quiet.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the living room HAMZA crouches down to little RIM's height, hands on his knees, asking her a question with a curious face; RIM looks up at him holding her doll.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment hallway, little RIM innocently points with her small hand toward a closed bedroom door at the end of the corridor, smiling; HAMZA beside her stares at the closed door, frozen, mouth open.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of HAMZA in the hallway, hand clutching his chest, eyes wide in total shock, as if hit on the back of the head, dramatic shadows.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA runs fast down the narrow apartment corridor toward two closed bedroom doors, motion lines, tense determined face, dim light.
